content.text:
I'd say it's כלל. As far as I can tell from this page, it charges the lowest management fee for a keren hishtalmut that follows the S&P 500. I'm fairly sure, but I'd still call כלל or ask you before moving anything.

**What decided it.** Under the big title the page says the plans are listed "מהיקר לזול" (dearest to cheapest), with fees "מ־0.48% עד 0.7%". So I went down to the last rows.
- כלל shows "0.48% מהחיסכון" and "אין מההפקדות". I took that to mean they charge only on the money saved, and nothing on each deposit.
- מנורה מבטחים, just above it, shows 0.49%.
- The very last company, אילון קופות גמל, has "עוד לא דווח" instead of a number, with a little warning sign. Its other numbers, 40% and 54%, don't look like the others. It's marked "חדש" and manages only 810 million. I wouldn't go with a company that hasn't reported its fee.
- At the top, מור charges 0.7%.

**What I looked at, in order.**
1. The title "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and the line under it saying the data is from רשות שוק ההון. That made it feel official.
2. The highlighted buttons "קרן השתלמות 154" and "עוקב מדד S&P 500 12". I read the English letters one by one.
3. The table, mostly the "דמי ניהול" column. I went from מור at the top down to כלל and אילון on the second screen.
4. The note under the table explaining "אין" and "עוד לא דווח".

**What I skipped.**
- The rings with the coloured dots and the "חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח" column. I can't tell the colours apart.
- The returns columns (13.67% and the others) and the "כסף מנוהל" amounts.
- The search box, the "מה זה קרן השתלמות" link and the footer links.

**Where I hesitated or wasn't sure.**
- Only two rows actually say "עוקב S&P 500": אלטשולר and אנליסט. For כלל it just says "12 מסלולים", so I'm not sure every company in the list really follows the S&P 500. I'm trusting the highlighted button.
- I didn't understand "מסלולים", "מט"ח", "PF-06", "לפני דמי ניהול" or the words "123 מקור / מחושב / הזנה" near the top.
- The row for מנורה מבטחים is cut in half between the two screens.

**What bothered me.**
- The screen is black, and the small grey writing is hard to read even enlarged.
- Lots of numbers in every row made me anxious.
- The order goes from expensive to cheap, so the cheapest one is at the very bottom.
- The returns are given for 3 and 5 years, and I don't know if that's per year. Many rows just say "פחות מ־5 שנים".
